notes.title: Discord server + Info about the drop system
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm happy so many people tried and (hopefully) enjoyed my game!
I thought I'd give some info about the skin pack drop system because the median playtime is much higher than I expected and I suspect some players go afk for skin drops which is great for me but the drop system does not reward you for playtime, you get a random skin pack once every 24 hours by playing the game for around a minute.
In addition, I'd love to hear your thoughts / suggestions in our [url=https://discord.gg/gC32XDckMM]discord server https://discord.gg/gC32XDckMM[/url]

Thank you for reading and have a nice day!
- YAGEL09

notes.title: Quick Patch Note July 2nd
notes.content: Fixed owned skins not showing up on the skins menu

notes.title: Platform Control on Steam!
notes.content:
I'm very excited to bring my mobile puzzle game to steam!
The game will launch with 50 levels and 6 platform types.
If the game will find some success and enough people will ask for it I might add steam workshop integration and a level editor in the future.
There are also skins and a skin drop system: a set of skins will drop once every 24 hours.
Oh and did I forget to mention? The game is FREE!

See you in game!
- YAGEL09
